resolved_conflicts.explanation: A July 1915 newspaper item says a cabin will be built. NHLR, firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts date the first 10x10 cab to 1922. The story gives both.
Idaho Fire Lookouts lists one long-serving attendant as 1976-2025, while a reader's comment on the same page says 1985 to 2025. The story gives no start year for that attendant.

notes_for_editor: Brief's record matches the sources on design, agency, registration and staffing. The first-cabin date is disputed (1915 newspaper vs 1922 elsewhere). Staffing as_of 2025 comes from the attendant list on Idaho Fire Lookouts; the summer-staffing statements on NHLR and firelookout.com are undated. A Facebook search snippet (not read, not used) gives 1917 for a 10x10 ground cab. The fs.fed.us Nez Perce lookouts page did not resolve, so it is not cited. The height_m of 3.0 is the record's value; the sources say 10 ft, which is about 3.05 m.
